answer: Enclave-anchored seats: every seat signs its answer with a hardware attestation key bound to one physical device, registered once in an on-chain bridge registry mapping key to device. A clone farm cannot mint more keys than it owns machines, so fifty fake seats cost fifty real boxes. Stakes sit in a shared vault and are slashed when two seats present keys sharing one attestation root. Registration reopens briefly at the epoch nadir, letting honest arrivals in while an orchard of flagged duplicate roots stays frozen.
